speaker: Dallin H. Oaks
role: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
title: The Gospel of Jesus Christ Is for All
summary: President Oaks teaches that this is Christ's Church and that His grace reaches everyone, everywhere, as the Book of Mormon shows. Speaking to members whose faith is fading, he says doubts, including clashes between science and religion, are overcome by drawing closer to Christ with humility, patience, the sacrament and the temple, because God knows all truth and expects us to learn by both scientific and spiritual methods. He urges members to keep their covenants, invites all to believe the Book of Mormon's promises, and calls on everyone to share these truths.
